20.description: Saskatoon will provide $1,500 in sponsorship for the Jashan-e-bahara & Kite Festival, an increase from $1,000 previously. The approved amount is less than the $2,500 requested.

chips.text: Approved
A councillor noted the committee was being arbitrary with funding amounts.
The Jashan-e-bahara & Kite Festival anticipates 1,000 attendees.
A question was raised about the completeness of the project budget details.

22.description: The Committee received a follow-up report on sponsorship funds already distributed to the Saskatoon Cricket Association for their Youth Cricket Winter Tournament in December 2025.

chips.text: Approved
Council members expressed confusion over the exact sponsorship amount.
Youth cricketers in Saskatoon benefit from the winter tournament.
A question was raised about recourse if the follow-up report was unsatisfactory.
Saskatoon Cricket Association committed to provide a follow-up report in early 2026.

21.description: The Planning and Development Subcommittee created a new onboarding package to help new committee members understand procedures and history, ensuring quick integration.

chips.text: Approved
Councillor noted this is the first onboarding document of its kind.
Staff committed to sending a finalized onboarding package to new members.

10.description: The item updates the 2026 budget for sponsorships, noting $6,500 remains available. A 2025 cricket tournament sponsorship was removed from the 2026 statement.

chips.text: Received as information
Saskatoon Cricket Association Inc. sponsorship was removed from 2026 budget.

23.description: Saskatoon's Diversity and Inclusion Consultant updated on Asian Heritage Month events, World Refugee Day, and civic naming, highlighting significant federal cuts to local immigration and settlement services.

chips.text: Approved
Councillor Justin noted demand for services will remain despite federal cuts.
Newcomers in Saskatoon will experience fewer available services.
New process established for naming University Heights Neighbourhood 3.
Friends of Asia volunteers are organizing Asian Heritage Month events.
Refugees will face co-payments for prescriptions and supplemental health services.
